proposed_branch: Explicitly instantiate and refine the same Ba/Li/Mg/Ge ordering in P4/mmm (No. 123), with Ba and Mg layers at z=0 and Li and Ge layers distributed over z=0 and 1/2, and compare it against P4mm using the same whole-profile model.
reason: The submitted CIF is valid: it parses and primitive-standardizes as fully occupied P4mm (No. 99), Z=1, with 7 atoms and exact BaLi2Mg2Ge2 composition in a=6.25352 A, c=5.05463 A; its periodic shells have no overlaps and are charge/topology plausible. Indexing is strong (25/25 lines, M(25)=170.7), with no important unindexed reflections, and an independent instantiated whole-profile fit gives Rwp=5.574% versus a free-line Pawley-like bound of 5.052%. However, the decisive exact-symmetry/coordinate choice is unresolved: snapping the same ordered sites to z=0 and 1/2 produces a concrete, compositionally and geometrically valid P4/mmm (No. 123) realization with minimum distance 2.527 A and Rwp=5.630%, only 0.056 percentage point worse than the submitted model and far smaller than the model-to-Pawley gap. Independent full-profile coordinate refinements also converge to differing z minima. Because this incompatible centrosymmetric realization is absent and is not quantitatively rejected, the lone P4mm CIF is not sufficiently established for exact recovery.
